posts.title: 120 Days
posts.description: It’s been 120 days, and only in the past week have I been thinking of you. But this past week has felt more and more painful each day. And as I resist the urge to send you a text, my heart pangs as I think of your situation, how you must have ached to reach out and talk to the old me while knowing that the person who would receive your message is was a stranger when you last met. posts.title: Moving On
posts.description: I wonder how many others had faced the same plight as I have. Less in this era perhaps, but across our history, there must be someone who feels as I do. I wonder what they would have done in my situation. Alas, there seems to be no point anymore reflecting and reliving the past, so perhaps now is the time, that I stop feeling and begin redirecting. These past few weeks have been quite peaceful --

posts.title: A Farewell To Naivety
posts.description: I had long thought that matters of the heart would not need bouts of rational thinking. That one day, I’d simply fall head over heels for someone and that would be the end of it. That the only people who would ever matter in the world would be my partner and me. But I’ve learned now that is not the case.
